EC1: - Greater than Stage 3 on the Hoehn & Yahr Classification of Disability
EC2: - decline in immune function such as pneumonia [OR] or systemic infection
EC4: - spinal fusion [OR] or other orthopedic surgery in the past six months
EC5: - mental disease/ [OR] psychosis such as dementia
EC6: - greater than minimal assistance required for gait [AND] and transfers
EC7: - [NOT] inability to make regular time commitments to the scheduled training sessions
EC8: - participation in resistance training on a regular basis within the past six months
